#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TARGET_ROOT="${HERMCLAW_RUNTIME_DIR:-/home/kiworker/noob2claw_runtime}"
TARGET="$TARGET_ROOT/agent_core"
BIN="$TARGET_ROOT/bin"
SOURCE_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/agent_core"

if [[ ! -f "$SOURCE_DIR/agent_core.py" ]]; then
  echo "agent_core/agent_core.py fehlt neben dem Installer." >&2
  exit 2
fi

mkdir -p "$TARGET" "$BIN"
cp -a "$SOURCE_DIR/." "$TARGET/"
chmod 0755 "$TARGET/agent_core.py"
cat > "$BIN/hermclaw-agent" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec python3 "$TARGET/agent_core.py" "\$@"
EOF
chmod 0755 "$BIN/hermclaw-agent"

printf 'Installiert: %s\n' "$TARGET"
printf 'Wrapper:     %s\n' "$BIN/hermclaw-agent"
printf '\nPreflight:\n  %s preflight --repo git@192.168.178.226:local-ai/hermclaw.git --base main\n' "$BIN/hermclaw-agent"
